Easy Chicken Fried Rice
5 from 12 votes
Print Recipe
Pin Recipe
This chicken fried rice is quicker than takeout and a great way to use up leftover rice.
Prep Time
10 mins
Cook Time
25 mins
Total Time
35 mins
Course
Main Course
Cuisine
Chinese
Keyword
chicken fried rice, fried rice
Servings
4
Calories
412kcal
Author
Jenn
Ingredients
▢ 1 cup long grain white rice
▢ 2 tablespoons vegetable oil divided
▢ 1 lb boneless skinless chicken breast diced
▢ 2 large eggs beaten
▢ 1 cup frozen peas and carrots
▢ 3 green onions sliced
▢ 3 tablespoons soy sauce
▢ 1 teaspoon sesame oil
Instructions
Step 1
Cook the rice according to the package directions, then spread it on a sheet pan to cool.
Step 2
Heat 1 tablespoon of the oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat and cook the chicken until golden, 6 to 8 minutes. Move it to a plate.
Step 3
Add the rest of the oil, scramble the eggs, then add the peas and carrots and cook for 2 minutes.
Step 4
Add the rice and chicken and stir-fry for 5 minutes, until the rice is hot and a little crisp.
Step 5
Stir in the soy sauce, sesame oil and green onions and serve.
Notes
Day-old rice fries best, so cook it the night before if you can.
Nutrition
Serving: 1.5cups | Calories: 412kcal | Carbohydrates: 52g | Protein: 27g | Fat: 10g | Sodium: 810mg
